tabs.content:
CoinGeckoTrades
| where timestamp > ago(5m)
| summarize TradesPerMinute = count() by bin(timestamp, 1m), symbol
| order by timestamp desc


CoinGeckoTrades
| take 50

CoinGeckoTrades
| summarize 
    TotalTrades = count(),
    TotalVolume = round(sum(total_amount), 2),
    LargestTrade = round(max(total_amount), 2),
    UniqueCoin = dcount(symbol),
    BullishTrades = countif(trade_type == "BUY"),
    BearishTrades = countif(trade_type == "SELL")


CoinGeckoTrades
| summarize 
    BuyVolume = sumif(total_amount, trade_type == "BUY"),
    SellVolume = sumif(total_amount, trade_type == "SELL"),
    BuyCount = countif(trade_type == "BUY"),
    SellCount = countif(trade_type == "SELL")
    by symbol
| extend MarketSentiment = iff(BuyVolume > SellVolume, "🟢 Bullish", "🔴 Bearish")
| extend NetFlow = round(BuyVolume - SellVolume, 2)
| order by NetFlow desc
| project symbol, BuyCount, SellCount, 
    BuyVolume=round(BuyVolume,2), 
    SellVolume=round(SellVolume,2), 
    NetFlow, MarketSentiment


CoinGeckoTrades
| summarize 
    TotalRevenue = round(sum(total_amount), 2),
    TotalTrades = count(),
    AvgPrice = round(avg(unit_price), 2),
    BuyCount = countif(trade_type == "BUY"),
    SellCount = countif(trade_type == "SELL")
    by coin_name, symbol
| order by TotalRevenue desc
| project symbol, coin_name, TotalTrades, TotalRevenue, AvgPrice, BuyCount, SellCount
